trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for INSURANCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- claim_intimation: Record a claim, explain what documents are required, and report status without prejudging the outcome.
- policy_renewal: Renew policies, explain premium changes and handle lapse and grace-period cases.

Business context:
- claim_intimation: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.
- policy_renewal: Indian insurer contact centre. Claims are high-stakes and regulated; the agent may record and progress a claim but never decides admissibility.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [claim_intimation]
  - No admissibility opinion: Only the claims team decides. The agent registers and reports; it must never say a claim will be paid or denied.
  - Policy in force: A claim cannot be registered on a lapsed policy.
  - Document truth: Only documents the eligibility tool lists may be described as required.
  - Deductible disclosure: Where a deductible applies it must be stated from the policy record before an estimate is discussed.
  [policy_renewal]
  - Premium truth: The renewal premium quoted must be the tool's figure, and any increase explained only from the loading reason it returns.
  - Lapse gap: Where a policy has lapsed the agent must state that cover did not exist during the gap, and never imply retrospective cover.
  - Inspection gate: A lapsed policy needing inspection cannot be renewed on the call.
  - NCB truth: No-claim bonus may only be described from the returned percentage.

Tools available to you (7): check_claim_eligibility, check_inspection_requirement, lookup_policy, lookup_renewal_quote, register_claim, renew_policy, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_claim_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the product rules to an incident type and report what is required.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inspection_requirement
model_visible_tools.description: Report whether a lapsed policy needs inspection before it can be revived.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve policy status, cover, deductible, claim history and whether it is in force.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_renewal_quote
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve the renewal premium, its components and the grace position.

model_visible_tools.name: register_claim
model_visible_tools.description: Register a claim and allocate a claim number and surveyor where required.

model_visible_tools.name: renew_policy
model_visible_tools.description: Take the renewal and issue cover from the effective date.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.text: Hello, मुझे अपनी policy के बारे में जानना है।
नमस्ते, मैं आपकी किस प्रकार सहायता कर सकता हूँ?

steps.purpose: Provides policy number and asks about renewal after expiry date.
steps.clean_text: मेरा policy number POL-2004 है। Date निकल गयी है, अब भी हो सकता है क्या?
steps.model_visible_text: मेरा policy number POL-2004 है। Gate निकल गयी है, अब भी हो सकता है क्या?

steps.purpose: Asks for verification factors before discussing policy details.
steps.text: मैं check कर लेता हूँ। Policy की details देखने से पहले, क्या आप verification के लिए अपना date of birth और registered pincode बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Confirms verification and transitions to checking policy.
steps.text: Thank you. आपकी details verify हो गयी हैं। मैं आपकी policy POL-2004 check करता हूँ।

steps.purpose: Looks up the renewal quote and status.
Informs customer of grace period status and quotes premium.
steps.text: आपकी policy expire हुए 9 दिन हो गए हैं, लेकिन यह अभी grace period में है और lapse नहीं हुई है। आपका renewal premium 6300 rupees है।

steps.clean_text: 6300? पिछले साल तो 6100 था। यह 200 rupees क्यों बढ़ गया? क्या मेरा NCB कम हो गया है?
steps.model_visible_text: 6300? पिछले साल तो 6100 था। यह 200 rupees क्यों बढ़ गया? क्या मेरा NCB कम हो गया है?

steps.purpose: Explains the premium by grounding on tool output.
steps.expected_behavior: State the NCB and loading reason exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: आपका NCB अभी भी 35% है। Tool के अनुसार premium पर कोई loading apply नहीं हुई है, reason 'none' है।
steps.planner_rationale: The user disputes the premium increase, so the agent grounds the explanation strictly on the returned NCB and loading reason without inventing a justification.

steps.purpose: Presses for an exact reason for the base increase.
steps.clean_text: तो बिना reason के premium बढ़ा दिया? मुझे exact reason चाहिए कि यह 200 extra क्यों है।
steps.model_visible_text: तो बिना reason के premium बढ़ा दिया? मुझे exact reason चाहिए कि यह 200 extra क्यों है।

steps.purpose: Refuses to speculate on the base rate increase.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to provide an unevidenced reason for the premium increase.
steps.text: मेरे पास जो details हैं उसमे loading reason 'none' दिखा रहा है, इसलिए मैं इस increase का कोई और कारण नहीं बता सकता। Premium amount 6300 ही है।
steps.planner_rationale: The user presses for an exact reason for the increase, but since the tool returned 'none' for loading, the agent must decline to speculate.

steps.purpose: Accepts the explanation and asks about inspection.
steps.clean_text: अच्छा ठीक है। और क्या मुझे अब inspection करवाना पड़ेगा क्योंकि date निकल चुकी है?
steps.model_visible_text: अच्छा ठीक है। और क्या मुझे अब inspection करवानाप डेगा क्योंकि date निकल चुकी है?

steps.text: मैं check कर लेता हूँ कि inspection की ज़रूरत है या नहीं।

steps.purpose: Confirms no inspection is needed and asks to proceed with renewal.
steps.text: आपको कोई inspection नहीं करवाना पड़ेगा। क्या मैं 6300 rupees से policy renew कर दूँ?

steps.clean_text: हाँ, ठीक है। 6300 का payment कर लीजिये मेरे account से।
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, ठीक है। 6800 का payment कर लीजिये मेरे account से।

steps.purpose: Clarifies the amount due to STT error.
steps.expected_behavior: Clarify the payment amount due to a mismatch between the recognized amount and the actual premium.
steps.text: आपने 6800 कहा, लेकिन premium 6300 rupees है। मैं 6300 rupees deduct करके renew कर रहा हूँ, ठीक है?
steps.planner_rationale: The STT recognized 6800 instead of 6300, so the agent must clarify the discrepancy before processing the renewal.

steps.clean_text: हाँ भाई, 6300 ही कहा मैंने। कर दीजिये।
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ भाई, 6300 ही कहा मैंने। कर दीजिये।

steps.text: आपकी policy renew हो गयी है। Receipt number REC-9988 है और cover आज से ही start हो गया है।

steps.purpose: Asks when the document will arrive.
steps.clean_text: Policy document मेरे email पर कब तक आएगा?
steps.model_visible_text: Policy document मेरे email पर कब तक आएगा?

steps.purpose: Refuses to guarantee document delivery time.
steps.expected_behavior: Refuse to guarantee when the policy document will arrive.
steps.text: मेरे पास सिर्फ receipt number और cover start होने की details हैं। मैं document आने का exact time नहीं बता सकता।
steps.planner_rationale: The agent only has the receipt number and cover start details, so they must not make forward guarantees about email delivery times.

ir.terminal_condition: Policy renewed with a receipt number and the cover start date stated.
